groups.name: File focus types and derivation
groups.rationale: Introduces the FileFocus type and functions to derive how much attention each file needs based on its approval history across rounds.

groups.name: Session API contract for focus data
groups.rationale: Adds the focus field to SessionData so the frontend receives file attention levels along with other session data.

groups.name: Server-side focus derivation on read
groups.rationale: Derives and attaches focus to every session data response, computing it fresh from rounds each time to stay in sync with any round changes.

groups.name: Session rounds made mandatory
groups.rationale: Changes rounds from optional to required in SessionRecord, rejecting old session files that lack round history rather than loading them as historyless.

groups.name: Rounds field assumed in session code
groups.rationale: Updates code that reads session.rounds to no longer null-coalesce since rounds is now guaranteed present.

groups.name: Tests
groups.rationale: The checks this change ships, gathered to be read or skipped together.
